item.title: Tecnologo: Southern Innovation Hub for Quantum Information (PIMIQ) (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-02 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-04 Fisica matematica

The Technologist will be employed in activities related to the functions of animation, marketing, and management of the infrastructure and technological services of the Innovation Cluster. In particular, the Technologist will be responsible for the preparation, validation, documentation, and provision of protocols and software tools for quantum computing. The activities will be aimed at producing tools, procedures, technical documentation, materials for testing and demonstration activities, as well as providing technical support for users in accessing and using the infrastructure and technological services of the Innovation Cluster.

item.title: Tecnologo: High Performance Computing infrastructure for Numerical Analysis of Metal Additive Manufacturing Systems Using Artificial Intelligence (AI4AM), CUP: I53C24001770006, Project code: EFRE1052, Programme ERDF 2021-2027 (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-05 Analisi numerica

The selected candidate will, in coordination with the scientific supervisor, support activities related to the development, implementation, and validation of computational methods for problems described by partial differential equations and finite element models. The activities will include the implementation and optimisation of simulation codes, including on parallel architectures and on the high-performance computing infrastructure of the artificial intelligence laboratory, as well as the processing and interpretation of numerical and/or experimental data supporting the construction of predictive models.
